default/32245.htm.text: Matras: I am Matras, the famous architect. You have heard of me, I trust? No? Ah, well... See that building over there? I designed it! What do you think of that?

Q00132_MatrasCuriosity/32245-01.htm.text: Matras: You know I am keenly interested in the magnificent structure called the Steel Citadel. I have been researching it, but strangely I have found no complete blueprints. It seems that it was built independently by a number of different parties... I am still searching for additional information,…

Q00132_MatrasCuriosity/32245-02.htm.text: Matras: I am very interested in this magnificent structure called the Steel Citadel, so I have been researching it. Ah, but I think you are too inexperienced to help me. Perhaps you will come again some day. (Only characters level 76 and higher may embark on this quest.)

Q00132_MatrasCuriosity/32245-05.htm.text: Matras: Ah, you have brought the blueprints I needed! Thank you! Now my research may progress as I had hoped. Ah, but let me just check to ensure that it is authentic... In my line of work, forgeries occur far too often. If it is the real item, I will reward you as I promised.

Q00132_MatrasCuriosity/32245-04.htm.text: Matras: Have you brought the blueprints? No? Then go to the Tower and get the Tower blueprints from Demon Prince and Ranku . I will reward you for your risk!

Q00132_MatrasCuriosity/32245-06.htm.text: Matras: Excellent -- the blueprints are authentic! Many thanks. I have already discovered several items of interest, including a secret passage...

Q00691_MatrasSuspiciousRequest/32245-01..text: Matras: Welcome, traveler! Would you be interested in a job, by any chance?

Q00691_MatrasSuspiciousRequest/32245-03..text: Matras: I am desperate for help, true, but still not so foolish as to engage someone of your obvious inexperience. Come back to me when you are a little more seasoned! (Only characters level 76 and above are permitted to undertake this quest.)

Q00691_MatrasSuspiciousRequest/32245-05..text: Matras: Thanks to your help, it has definitely already become easier for me to go in and out. You did well, my friend. Now, do you have the Red Stones I asked for?

Q00691_MatrasSuspiciousRequest/32245-07..text: Matras: Ah, I see that you've brought me %itemcount% Red Stones. What sort of reward would you like?

links.text: "Give me what you promised for bringing you 744 stones."
"I will go back and get some more stones."
"I've had enough of this. Give me a reward for the stones I have brought you."

Q00691_MatrasSuspiciousRequest/32245-06..text: Matras: Go do what I asked of you: get rid of the tower guards and bring me the Red Stones they carry. Hurry!

Q00132_MatrasCuriosity/32245-03.htm.text: Matras: Actually, I need a blueprint of the structure of the tower of the Steel Citadel. I have learned who possesses the information I need, but I can't get it on my own. Perhaps...someone like you could go into the tower, find that blueprint and bring it to me. Apparently the Demon Prince and Ran…

Q00132_MatrasCuriosity/32245-03a.htm.text: Matras: Actually, I need a blueprint of the structure of the tower of the Steel Citadel. I have learned who possesses the information I need, but I can't get it on my own. Perhaps...someone like you could go into the tower, find that blueprint and bring it to me. Apparently the Demon Prince and Ran…

Q00132_MatrasCuriosity/32245-07.htm.text: Matras: I am going to tell you this secret because I only found out about it thanks to your help. Apparently, there is a passage that leads directly to the second tower of the Steel Citadel . I found it easily enough, and I think you will, too. In fact, if you want to use that passage, go speak wit…

Q00691_MatrasSuspiciousRequest/32245-02..text: Matras: I must go up to the tower of the Steel Citadel, but to do so requires passing Bate Tower. The guards there refused to let me enter. That's why I need your help...

Q00691_MatrasSuspiciousRequest/32245-04..text: Matras: All you have to do is simply draw their attention and I will take care of the rest. Although now that I think it through, it would be even better if you could, uh, get rid of them. Do so and bring me the Red Stones that they carry. No questions! I told you I would reward you well for your t…

Q00691_MatrasSuspiciousRequest/32245-08..text: Matras: You have brought %itemcount% Red Stones. I wish it were more, but it looks like you have worked hard to get these. What do you want me to do with these?

links.text: "Give me what you promised for bringing you 744 stones."
"I will go back and get some more stones."
"I've had enough of this. Give me a reward for the stones I have brought you."

Q00691_MatrasSuspiciousRequest/32245-09..text: Matras: Here you go. I hope this will help you in your travels. Take care!

Q00691_MatrasSuspiciousRequest/32245-10..text: Matras: Look, I've told you many times that I need 744 Red Stones. However, you've given me only %itemcount% so far. Go get some more if you expect me to reward you.

Q00691_MatrasSuspiciousRequest/32245-11..text: Matras: Thank you! I will not forget your help. Allow me to compensate you for your excellent work.

Q00691_MatrasSuspiciousRequest/32245-12..text: Matras: Good work! If I need your services again, I won't hesitate to call on you.
